workspaces.description: BloodHound uses graph theory to reveal the hidden and often unintended relationships within an Active Directory or Azure environment.

With graphql-voyager you can visually explore your GraphQL API as an interactive graph. This is a great tool when designing or discussing your data model. It includes multiple example GraphQL schemas and also allows you to connect it to your own GraphQL endpoint.
workspaces.notes: This workspace uses a locally hosted graphql-voyager so that it won't leak your target's data.

Kali Linux is a Debian-derived Linux distribution designed for digital forensics and penetration testing.
workspaces.notes:
This low memory workspace is allocated 1536MB of RAM.

This Kali workspace extends the Kasm Kali workspace as follows:
  - password-less sudo
  - more packages including Burp Suite Pro, Postman, ZAP weekly, Caido
  - VPN sidecar support when the VPN network device is bound to x.x.x.2

If a network is selected where the x.x.x.2 address is a gateway, traffic will be routed through it. This allows a VPN to run as a container and be shared across containers.
